mistake_reason: FileSurfer had already computed and stated that 'Out of the Silent Planet' had the lowest words/day (step 10), but at step 12 they withheld this critical insight by excluding that entry from the sorted ranking without sharing the specific details or confirming the anomaly. This information withholding (FM-2.4) misled the team to select 'Dune' as the slowest, causing the wrong final answer.
